title: Expert Role — kuhul micronaut expert pool entry
description: Describes one expert in a micronaut pool. Matches the runtime_expert adapter format used in atomic.manifest.json (programs, fold_chat, coder adapters). Fields weight/confidence/relevance seed the D3D11 MicronAutGPU struct for dispatch_micronaut_admission.

expert_id.description: Zero-based index into the micronaut GPU pool (MicronAutGPU.capability)

kind.description: Adapter kind. runtime_expert = portable, not bound to a specific runtime

portable.description: If true, expert loads onto any compatible carrier model

domain.description: Free-text domain scope, e.g. 'programs — stdlib verbs, op dispatch, phase law'

path.description: Path to LoRA .safetensors or full-weight checkpoint. Matches atomic.manifest.json .adapters[*].path

training.description: Training quality label, e.g. 'finetooth combed'. Matches atomic.manifest.json .adapters[*].training

applies_to.description: File extensions this expert handles, e.g. [".kuhul", ".khl"]

weight.description: Initial GPU pool weight (load_balance from MoE). Seeds MicronAutGPU.weight

confidence.description: Router confidence for this expert. Seeds MicronAutGPU.confidence

phase.description: Binary phase activation pattern (aligns with K'UHUL fold phase encoding)

load_balance.description: Fraction of tokens routed to this expert (from MoE load_balancing_stats)

routing_weight.description: Top-k gating network output weight for this expert

examples.domain: code generation — KSON AST, grammar, micronaut-coder tools
examples.note: runtime-agnostic expertise; loads onto any compatible carrier model
